title: Short circuit cuts power to parts of Israel for about 20 minutes, Cedar News reports
geo_basis: country; the article names Shoham and Lehavim residents but gives no single location
summary: A short circuit cut power to parts of Israel for about 20 minutes on Thursday evening, according to Cedar News. The article says the utility traced the fault to the electrical feed serving one of its generating units and that it had restored service to all affected customers. Claims of an attack circulated; the utility attributed the disruption to the short circuit.
plain: Parts of Israel lost power for about 20 minutes. Cedar News reports the Israel Electric Corporation attributed it to a short circuit and said service was restored; claims of an attack circulated.
exec: Cedar News reports a power cut of about 20 minutes in parts of Israel, which the utility attributed to a short circuit.

evidence.quote: A short circuit cut power to parts of Israel for about 20 minutes

validation.note: Only Cedar News read; the utility's own statement is relayed by it and was not read directly.

review.note: stronger than the source: plain said the utility did not back attack claims, but the source only says it attributed the outage to a short circuit; title garbled. Now attributed to Cedar News.
